name: Vite + React + TypeScript
description: Web app scaffolded from the official create-vite react-ts template.

commands.test: npm run build && npm run lint

notes: Start the dev server in the background (npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173 > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &) and test the app with the Playwright browser tools at http://127.0.0.1:5173. The browser window is visible on the agent's desktop.
